The PIN cannot be recovered. If it is forgotten, clearing app data or uninstalling removes both the PIN and all saved credentials. There is no cloud backup. Do this only if you accept losing the vault.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$d seconds.
PIN protection could not be read or saved. Access remains protected.
We recommend setting a PIN to protect access to your passwords. Choose one you can remember: it cannot be recovered.

Credentials are stored only on this device, encrypted using AES-256-GCM with a key in Android Keystore. TV Vault has no Internet permission or cloud sync. The optional PIN protects app access; requiring it for autofill is configurable. It does not derive the encryption key. Without a PIN, anyone who can use the app can access the vault. A rooted or compromised device may expose credentials. Autofill requires compatible apps and Android support. There is no export or recovery feature: clearing app data, uninstalling, or losing the key may permanently lose the vault. TV Vault has not undergone an independent security audit.
The vault could not be read or decrypted. Saving is blocked to protect existing data. Do not clear app data or uninstall. Retry, or seek help while preserving the installation.
The vault could not be saved. The change has not been accepted. Existing data will not be replaced if reading or encryption fails.
